relationship: One grouped distribution is represented by histogram bar areas and cumulative-frequency growth, so changing an interval affects both displays and quartile read-offs.

learnerLoop.action: Build intervals, read quartiles and alter a histogram bar.
learnerLoop.modelChange: Frequency density, bar area, cumulative totals and quartile estimates update together.
learnerLoop.evidence: The linked histogram, curve, highlights and working checks expose the same grouped data.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Use the linked representation to locate the next quartile or explain the IQR.

invariants: Histogram area represents frequency even when class widths differ.
Cumulative frequency never decreases and ends at the total frequency.
safeAdaptations: Vary valid grouped intervals and frequencies while retaining linked displays.
Change working support without disconnecting quartile evidence from the cumulative curve.
nonGoals: Using bar height alone as frequency for unequal-width classes.
